intro: Lesson 44: Timed Section C piece (45 minutes). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Today's three tasks
points: (a) 'Everyone should learn to cook before leaving school.' Discuss.
(b) Write a story that begins: 'Nobody had opened the gate for years.'
(c) Describe a road during the first snow of winter.

panels.title: Before you start
points: Choose the task you can plan fastest

keywords.def: keeping quality high for the whole time

questions.q: Choose your task and write a five-line plan (7 minutes).
questions.a: A choice and a five-line plan in the right shape.

questions.q: Core (exam conditions, 30 minutes): write your Section C piece in the portal response box or on paper.
questions.a: A complete piece in the chosen form with controlled structure and accurate writing (marked with the 4EB1 Section C criteria).

questions.q: Edit and proofread with the five-minute routine.
One word here: how did the timing feel?
